title: Hang
description:
Deal 10 damage.
Double the damage ALL Hang cards deal to this enemy.
upgraded_description:
Deal 13 damage.
Double the damage ALL Hang cards deal to this enemy.
notes: Each time this card is played against the same enemy, it applies an amount of Hang Power equal to max(2, current_amount), effectively doubling the power stack with overflow protection at 999,999,999. The Hang Power multiplies all damage dealt by Hang cards to that enemy by the power's stack amount.
